overload.syntax: protected internal virtual bool ShouldCompressContent ( TargetPlatform targetPlatform, Object value )

parameters.parameter: The target platform of the content build.
The object about to be serialized, or null if a collection of objects is to be serialized.

overload.returns: true if the content of the requested type should be compressed; false otherwise.
overload.remarks: This base class implementation of this method always returns true . It should be overridden to return false if there would be little or no useful reduction in size of the content type's data from a general-purpose lossless compression algorithm. The implementations for Song Class and SoundEffect Class data return false because data for these content types is already in compressed form.
